Name: Unicorns for Barn
Author: Syanide23
Description:
Adds two types of unicorns purchasable from Marnie's shop that live in the barn. 

The black unicorn produces void essence and black horns while the solar unicorn produces solar essence and white horns. They produce every 3 days and mature in 14 days. The Big Barn is required for them to be unlocked. The horns can be put in a bone mill to produce fairy dust!

For the black unicorn there is an option to select a version with orange hair, based off of Zoo Tycoon 2!
